title: Serino 2018 · mixed-reality audiovisual–tactile PPS
citation: Serino, A., Noel, J. P., Mange, R., Canzoneri, E., Pellencin, E., Ruiz, J. B., Bernasconi, F., Blanke, O., & Herbelin, B. (2018). Peripersonal Space: An Index of Multisensory Body–Environment Interactions in Real, Virtual, and Mixed Realities. Frontiers in ICT, 4, 31.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

visual.object: Virtual tennis ball approaches the face, starting nominally 2 m away.

published_method.target: 10 ms solenoid pulse to right cheek.
published_method.response: Make a speeded button press when the cheek is touched; ignore the animated ball and withhold on trials without touch.
published_method.analysis: Compare each multisensory delay's mean RT with the participant's fastest mean tactile-only delay. Fit the uncorrected multisensory means for the PPS transition.
published_method.audio: A prerecorded binaural white-noise source follows the tennis ball toward the participant with matched speed and direction.

value.tactile: Mechanical solenoid tap to right cheek

stimulus_type.source: Frontiers p. 5, Visual Stimuli and Fig. 3C–D and Frontiers pp. 4–5, Acoustic Stimuli and Fig. 3A–B and Frontiers p. 6, Procedure

auditory.source: Spatialized white noise prerecorded with 3Dio Omni binaural microphones
auditory.motion: Presented simultaneously with the virtual ball, with matching speed and direction

source_provenance.source: Frontiers pp. 4–5, Acoustic Stimuli and Fig. 3A–B and Frontiers p. 6, Procedure
source_provenance.gap: Original scene, WAV and XML schedule unavailable.

trajectory_count.gap: The procedure specifies one looming ball path.

value.auditory: Motion matched to ball in speed and direction

trajectory_path.source: Frontiers p. 5, Visual Stimuli and Fig. 3C–D and Frontiers p. 6, Procedure
trajectory_path.gap: Published nominal path is 200 cm. The reported 75 cm/s × 2.6 s gives 195 cm. Start position and contact geometry require the original scene settings for exact reproduction.

stimulus_duration.gap: Visual stimulation stated identical to Experiment 1. Audio file length and tails unreported.

stimulus_speed.source: Frontiers p. 5, Visual Stimuli and Fig. 3C–D and Frontiers p. 6, Procedure
stimulus_speed.gap: Audio speed reported to match visual ball.

auditory_conditions.gap: The sound accompanies the ball during trimodal stimulation.

gain_envelope.source: Frontiers pp. 4–5, Acoustic Stimuli and Fig. 3A–B
gain_envelope.gap: The prerecorded spatialized sound is described. Its exact waveform, levels and per-speaker envelopes unreported.

value.scene_capture: Seven stereoscopic GoPro Hero4 pairs on 3D 360hero 3DH3PRO14H rig
value.video_stitching: Two panoramic views, one per eye
value.audio_capture: Four pairs of 3Dio Omni binaural microphones with interpolation between directions
value.body_view: First-person stereoscopic video of the user's own body overlaid on the panoramic scene
value.tracking: Head rotation around the captured viewpoint
value.source: Spatialized white noise prerecorded with 3Dio Omni binaural microphones
value.motion: Presented simultaneously with the virtual ball, with matching speed and direction

renderer_or_apparatus.source: Frontiers pp. 3–4, Technological Components and Fig. 2 and Frontiers pp. 4–5, Acoustic Stimuli and Fig. 3A–B
renderer_or_apparatus.gap: Original code, sound and hardware calibration unavailable.

trial_rows_families.gap: 540 total minus 60 catches leaves 480 trials. Five delays × 12 repetitions gives 60 trials per reported condition. The article does not enumerate eight contributing condition pools or give the exact trimodal and tactile-only allocation.

condition_intermixing.gap: The exact Experiment 2 intermixing and ordering procedure is unspecified.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Four blocks of 135 trials, approximately 12 minutes each.
blocked_or_random_order.gap: Exact randomization and per-block condition balance unreported.

iti_jitter_policy.value: Visual presentation described as the same as Experiment 1.
iti_jitter_policy.gap: An independent Experiment 2 trial timing or jitter table is unreported.

response_window.gap: The article specifies speeded button detection. Online timeout and RT inclusion window unreported.

task_sequence_rules.value: Respond to right-cheek tap. Ignore the approaching audiovisual stimulus. Withhold when touch is absent.

tactile_stimulus.source: Frontiers pp. 3–4, Technological Components and Fig. 2
tactile_stimulus.gap: Amplitude, pulse calibration and threshold procedure unreported.

soa_table.source: Frontiers p. 6, Procedure and Frontiers pp. 8–9, Experiment 2 Results and Fig. 5
soa_table.gap: Numeric touch offsets and distances unreported.

baseline_strategy.value: Tactile-only controls. Subtract the fastest mean baseline delay per participant.
baseline_strategy.source: Frontiers pp. 6–7, Analysis and Eq. 1 and Frontiers pp. 8–9, Experiment 2 Results and Fig. 5

catch_trial_type.source: Frontiers pp. 5–6, Experimental Design and Procedure and Frontiers pp. 6–7, Analysis and Eq. 1
catch_trial_type.gap: The Experimental Design and Procedure describe visual-only catches. The Analysis refers to auditory/visual catches. Exact Experiment 2 catch modality and allocation require the original protocol.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.gap: 540 total minus 60 catches leaves 480 trials. Five delays × 12 repetitions gives 60 trials per reported condition. The article does not enumerate eight contributing condition pools or give the exact trimodal and tactile-only allocation.

baseline_count.gap: 540 total minus 60 catches leaves 480 trials. Five delays × 12 repetitions gives 60 trials per reported condition. The article does not enumerate eight contributing condition pools or give the exact trimodal and tactile-only allocation.

implementation_gaps: The source stereoscopic scene and first-person body capture, tennis-ball placement, exact tactile delay table and participant-specific geometry are unavailable.

Requires rendering of the scene and approaching ball against a calibrated headset clock with 10 ms mechanical right-cheek stimulation and an aligned button response. The audio-tactile runner does not reproduce the mixed-reality task.
The synchronized binaural asset captured with the study's 16-speaker array and the playback gain/calibration settings are unavailable.
The article's repetitions-by-delay statement does not establish the exact 480 noncatch trial allocation across the conditions. Do not infer Experiment 1's allocation.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
